subject: 0112 surface reservation DONE (host-only) + P14 images
body:
0112 DONE (host-only, nothing flashed). Selectors 13 RESERVE / 14 RETIRE exactly per the contract: probe n=0 -> {success, R=0}; n>8/unknown/non-imported/other-context handle -> BadArgument; 5th live reservation in a ctx -> Busy (R out 0); RETIRE seq=0 cancel, seq!=0 busy until all jobs of the ctx with id<=seq are terminal (done/fault->verified stop or reset/cancelled/reset), R=0 no-op, unknown R -> NotFound, seq never issued -> BadArgument. nord2_gpu_surface_busy(S) now also true for reserved S (same gpu lock; RESERVE returns after visible). Fail-safe: 200 ms expiry of unretired (resv_expired), ctx close and GPU reset drop reservations, max 4/ctx and 32 total, tokens only (no BO refs, no deref). Logs: JOBS ... resv=reserves/retires/cancels/expired ; FB PRESENT ... resv_expired=N. Kill switch boot-arg n2resv=0 (nord2_gpu_resv=0): both selectors incl. the n=0 probe answer kIOReturnUnsupported so the frontend must fall back. Validator: RESERVE ni=1 no>=1 structIn=4*n (n<=8, no wrap), RETIRE ni=2 no>=0; both work through the 0111 trap path (trap ABI test extended).
Tests: nord2_core_test 26 scenarios (+3, mutation-checked: no expiry / no drop on close / no drop on reset / non-terminal release / no per-ctx limit / no imported check each fail), transport + trap_abi extended; run_all.sh GATE green (8 FINAL, 6 XNU, 2 MODEL pass; 32/32 stage-vs-candidate identical; 4 SNAPSHOT fail expected = pre-0088 transport + core 0091/0096/0105 mutation check of 0108).
Images (P14, series ..0111,0112, kernel A sha aa5cc18eee494e83): ui654fb60 = d766ae16ff93038d (n2fbhz=60, 595 chars); ui654fb60noresv = c6f54aeb1cf206bc (+n2resv=0, 604 chars). Patches: 0112-display-surface-reservation.patch b0bb38723424f64f, candidate-gpu-source-0112.patch 0d40b8a0e0137ce5. README: gpu/build/kernel-p1-20261026/README-0112.md. For the encode agent: ABI constants NORD2_GPU_SEL_SURFACE_RESERVE=13, _RETIRE=14, NORD2_GPU_RESERVE_MAX=8 in gpu/include/nord2_gpu_transport.h (patch 0112; apply to the repo via candidate-gpu-source-0112.patch, parent owns integration). Handles must be this context's IMPORT_SURFACE handles; retire seq = id of the last SUBMIT_JM of the frame (must have been issued).
